def recv_obj(self, src: int) -> Any:
        """Receive an object from a source rank."""
        key = f"send_to/{self.rank}/{self.recv_src_counter[src]}"
        signed_payload = self.store.get(key)
        payload, digest = signed_payload[:-32], signed_payload[-32:]
        if not hmac.compare_digest(digest, hmac.digest(key.encode(), payload, "sha256")):
            raise ValueError("Refusing to deserialize unauthenticated process-group payload")
        obj = pickle.loads(payload)
        self.recv_src_counter[src] += 1
        return obj
